content.text: **Finding: compliant.** Section 21 matches our preferred position in full.

input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets the preferred position without change. 21.1 sets a genuinely mutual cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable by Customer in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000; "Fees" (§1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the base is meaningful, and the USD 1,000,000 floor prevents an illusory cap. 21.2 excludes indirect/consequential damages mutually and expressly preserves data-restoration, replacement-service, notification and incident-response costs as direct damages. 21.3 places all required carve-outs outside the cap — confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other Party's IP — and confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not "damages" subject to the cap. 21.4 preserves unlimited liability where the law forbids limitation and makes each cap independent of exclusive-remedy failure; §18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No competing cap or one-sided liability language appears in the warranty (§19) or indemnity (§20) sections. No redline required.
